reason: H0 never calls either changed public tangentspace entry point. It therefore cannot exercise the revised normalization and smoothing behavior in meshopt_generateNormals/smoothNormals or the zero-vector fallback controlled by meshopt_TangentZeroFallback in meshopt_generateTangents.
evidence: tools/clusterfuzz.cpp covers meshlet construction and meshopt_partitionClusters, tools/codecfuzz.cpp covers codec and meshlet encode/decode APIs, and tools/simplifyfuzz.cpp covers simplification APIs; none invokes meshopt_generateNormals or meshopt_generateTangents.

meshopt_generateNormals consumes topology through indices/index_count, floating-point vertex_positions with configurable vertex_positions_stride, crease_angle, and smoothing; S1 moves root normalization before smoothing and makes smoothNormals renormalize after each pass.

meshopt_generateTangents contains changed behavior for zero-length accumulated tangents based on the meshopt_TangentZeroFallback option, but H0 does not vary that option or supply degenerate tangent-space inputs.
recommended_action: Add a tangentspace fuzz target that generates indexed and unindexed triangle meshes, including duplicate vertices, isolated or degenerate triangles, zero/non-finite/extreme float components, and valid stride variants; fuzz crease_angle and smoothing (including fractional values and the 10-pass clamp) for meshopt_generateNormals, and vary meshopt_TangentZeroFallback plus normals and UVs for meshopt_generateTangents. Check memory safety and finite/unit-length or documented zero/fallback output invariants.
